title: Owner-bound public Production runtime readback R7

phases.objective: Provide a reusable owner-bound, public-HTTPS-GET-only readback that compares the exact protected Production ref with public runtime SHA and branch provenance after each governed Git promotion.

e2e_journeys.actor: Repository owner performing post-promotion runtime verification
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: An exact issue or pull-request comment using RUN_HOSTINGER_PRODUCTION_RUNTIME_READBACK_R7 expected_production_sha=<40-hex-sha>
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow publishes scrubbed Artifact and conversation evidence that classifies the runtime as production_current only when all four public endpoints return HTTP 200 and both runtime SHA and branch provenance exactly match the protected Production ref.
steps: Validate the trigger author identity and exact 40-hex expected Production SHA command.
Checkout trusted default-branch tooling without persisted credentials.
Read protected main and Production refs and require the Production ref to equal the expected SHA before collection.
Fetch health, version, deployment-info, and connector-agent version through bounded public HTTPS GET requests.
Scrub sensitive response keys and derive exact SHA, branch, HTTP, and classification evidence.
Re-read the protected Production ref after collection to reject ref movement during the evidence cycle.
Upload bounded evidence, publish a secret-free repository comment, and fail closed unless production_current is true.
assertions: Only the repository owner numeric identity can trigger the workflow.
The command must contain exactly one lowercase 40-hex expected Production SHA.
The protected Production ref is read before and after public runtime collection and must remain exact.
The workflow uses no Hostinger credential or provider API token.
The workflow performs no build creation, deployment, release activation, restart, SQL, Migration Apply, database mutation, protected-ref mutation, force push, or external business send.
Runtime currentness requires HTTP 200 for all four endpoints, exact SHA parity in version and deployment-info, and exact Production branch provenance.
All persisted evidence is bounded, scrubbed, and secret-free.

phases.objective: Allow an exact owner comment to generate same-cycle public runtime evidence and a bounded repository decision comment.
Fail closed on malformed commands, protected-ref movement, DNS or HTTP failure, non-JSON or oversized responses, runtime SHA mismatch, and branch provenance mismatch.
Execute the first exact Production readback after merge and preserve the run, job, Artifact, and bounded result comment as acceptance evidence.
This read-only evidence workflow never performs a Production ref change, Hostinger provider mutation, deployment, restart, SQL, Migration Apply, or database mutation.
